_readme: Hand-entered beer deals and places, committed to git so we can both add to it.
Use this for deals we've seen in person, on a chalkboard, on Instagram, got from the owner, or read on the bar's OWN menu (website or the menu it keeps on Untappd).
Never a blog, review or travel guide: those prices are secondhand and go stale.
Match a place by its exact name (as shown in the app) plus 'near' [lat, lng] (must be within 1 mile), or by 'venueId'.
kind: regular | happy_hour | special. days: 0=Sun..6=Sat. start/end: 24h 'HH:MM'. size: 'pint', '16oz', '500ml', '6-pack'...
currency: 'EUR' for Europe (default is dollars). url: where the price was read. date: when we checked it. note: the original text.
menuDate: when the menu itself is dated ('2025-05'), shown on the card as 'dated May 2025'. Use it whenever a PDF or page carries a date.
source 'team' = we confirmed it with the bar ourselves (shows a 'Verified' badge); otherwise it shows 'From their menu'.
happyHours: windows without a fixed price (e.g. '2nd drink 75% off'), same matching fields plus days/start/end/note/url.
Delete the example entries below once we have real ones; they're marked 'example': true and ignored.
